name: Binary Logistic Regression
when_to_use: Binary dependent variable (0/1); evaluation by log-likelihood, AIC/BIC, pseudo-R² and ROC curve.

expected_input.question: How to predict the probability of a category?

plain_explanation.purpose: Calculates the chance of something happening or not (yes/no) from factors.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the outcome is of two types: bought/did not buy, paid/did not pay.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A response column with two values (0/1) and factor columns.
plain_explanation.example: Estimate the chance of a quote becoming a sale based on value and channel.
plain_explanation.diagram: factors -> [model] -> chance from 0% to 100% -> cutoff (e.g., above 50% = yes)
